data.one_liner: Cross‑platform settings UI widget set for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides native‑looking settings screens for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web with split view support and a single API.
use_when: When you need a consistent settings UI across multiple platforms
When you want to avoid writing platform‑specific code for settings screens
avoid_when: When you require highly custom UI that this package does not support
strengths: Split view for tablets and desktops
weaknesses: Not compatible with apps that still use flutter/material.dart
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies: settings_ui, material_ui, cupertino_ui. Ensure Flutter SDK >=3.44. No build_runner needed.
